sequence.speaker: Erma
sequence.text: Heavens, Look who finally decided to come outside.

sequence.speaker: Erma
sequence.text: Well...? Aren't you going to say anything?

sequence.speaker: Erma
sequence.text: Your yard is a bit of an eyesore.

sequence.speaker: Erma
sequence.text: The bushes haven't been pruned, your lawn is overgrown, for heaven's sake, the ivy looks to have taken over your house.

sequence.speaker: Erma
sequence.text: You used to be on top of your yard work, you'd even offer to mow mine and the other neighbor's lawn. We all have responsibilities to uphold, even if we don't feel like it.

sequence.speaker: Erma
sequence.text: Why don't you at least start by getting the mail. Heavens, your Mailbox is practically bursting at the seams.

sequence.speaker: Erma
sequence.text: Veronica has been asking about you, maybe you should talk to her while you're up. She should be working down at the store right now... Business has been slow, so I am sure she would enjoy some company.

sequence.speaker: Erma
sequence.text: Anyway, it's nice to see you up and about.
